title: isoetes coromandelina subsp. brachyglossa

This plant is believed to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Isoetes coromandelina subsp. brachyglossa include its potential to act as an anti-diabetic agent, with its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, exhibiting insulin-like properties.
